```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())
setwd(".")  # run from the scripts/ directory
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

load("correlation_functions_updated.rda")
load("gba_functions.rda")
```

```{r load}
## Consensus half-life fold change -- SE < 0.75, c1 fitting, n = 3358
df_consensus <- read_tsv("../output_tables/df_WT_consensus_hl_fc.txt",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

## Vijjamarri et al. 2023 -- Dcp2 and Xrn1 deletion steady-state RNA-seq
## CAVEAT: deletion mutants, transcriptional buffering likely
df_vijjamarri <- read_tsv("../tables/df_vijjamarri_gba.txt",
                           show_col_types = FALSE)

## Chappleboim et al. 2022 -- AID depletion time course at 60 min
## Strains: XRN1-AID, Not1-AID, CCR4-AID, Pop2-AID, dcp2-AID
df_chappleboim <- read_tsv("../tables/df_chappleboim_gba.txt",
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

## Audebert et al. 2024 -- SLAM-seq half-life fold changes
## Direct half-life measurements after Pop2/CCR4 and Dcp2 depletion
df_audebert <- read_tsv("../tables/df_audebert_gba.txt",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

## Alalam et al. 2022 -- SLAM-seq half-life fold changes
## Direct half-life measurements in upf3Δ vs WT
df_alalam <- read_tsv("../tables/df_alalam_gba.txt",
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

## He et al. 2018 (GSE107841) -- Decapping activator deletions
## pat1Δ, lsm1Δ, dhh1Δ vs WT steady-state RNA-seq
## CAVEAT: deletion mutants, transcriptional buffering likely
df_he2018 <- read_tsv("../tables/df_he2018_gba.txt",
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

## In-house RNA-seq -- AID depletion in small and large cells
## Factors: Not1, Pab1, Xrn1, eIF4E, eIF4G
## log2FC PhIAA_1hr vs DMSO_1hr
## NOTE: requires CW13 to be run first
df_yuyang <- read_tsv("../tables/df_yuyang_gba.txt",
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Consensus:", nrow(df_consensus), "genes\n")
cat("Vijjamarri:", nrow(df_vijjamarri), "genes\n")
cat("Chappleboim:", nrow(df_chappleboim), "genes\n")
cat("Audebert:", nrow(df_audebert), "genes\n")
cat("Alalam:", nrow(df_alalam), "genes\n")
cat("He2018:", nrow(df_he2018), "genes\n")
cat("In-house RNA-seq:", nrow(df_yuyang), "genes\n")
```

```{r process_eif4g}
## eIF4G depletion fold change -- MS908 (eIF4G-AID) vs MS1039 DMSO control
## SE < 0.75 filter applied throughout

sample_info <- read_csv("../tables/sample_info_combined.csv",
                        show_col_types = FALSE)

df_c1 <- read_tsv("../output_tables/df_fit_output_c1.txt",
                  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(sample_info, by = "experiment_strain_condition") %>%
  filter(std.error_log_k < 0.75,
         estimate_half_life > 0)

df_ms1039_wt <- df_c1 %>%
  filter(label %in% c("MS1039_small", "MS1039_large")) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, label, estimate_half_life) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = label,
              values_from = estimate_half_life,
              names_glue  = "{label}_hl_wt") %>%
  filter(!is.na(MS1039_small_hl_wt), !is.na(MS1039_large_hl_wt),
         MS1039_small_hl_wt > 0, MS1039_large_hl_wt > 0)

df_ms908 <- df_c1 %>%
  filter(strain == "MS908") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, label, estimate_half_life) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = label,
              values_from = estimate_half_life,
              names_glue  = "{label}_hl") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl),
    !is.na(MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl),
    !is.na(MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl),
    !is.na(MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl),
    MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl > 0,
    MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl > 0,
    MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl > 0,
    MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    MS908_small_hl = rowMeans(across(c(MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl,
                                       MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl)),
                              na.rm = TRUE),
    MS908_large_hl = rowMeans(across(c(MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl,
                                       MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl)),
                              na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, MS908_small_hl, MS908_large_hl)

df_eif4g <- df_ms908 %>%
  inner_join(df_ms1039_wt, by = "gene_id") %>%
  mutate(
    eIF4G_dep_fc_small = log2(MS908_small_hl / MS1039_small_hl_wt),
    eIF4G_dep_fc_large = log2(MS908_large_hl / MS1039_large_hl_wt),
    eIF4G_dep_fc_mean  = (eIF4G_dep_fc_small + eIF4G_dep_fc_large) / 2) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(eIF4G_dep_fc_small),
    is.finite(eIF4G_dep_fc_large),
    is.finite(eIF4G_dep_fc_mean))

cat("Genes with eIF4G FC data:", nrow(df_eif4g), "\n")
```

```{r build_long}
## Build single long-format table: gene_id | variable | value
## Variables:
##   WT_hl_fc              -- our fold change (large/small), primary outcome
##   WT_small_hl           -- consensus half-life in small cells
##   WT_large_hl           -- consensus half-life in large cells
##   log2FC_dcp2D          -- Dcp2 deletion, Vijjamarri (steady-state)
##   log2FC_xrn1D_vij      -- Xrn1 deletion, Vijjamarri (steady-state)
##   TE_vijjamarri         -- WT TE, Vijjamarri
##   log2FC_not1_60        -- Not1-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_xrn1_60        -- XRN1-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_ccr4_60        -- CCR4-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_pop2_60        -- Pop2-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60  -- dcp2-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl    -- Pop2/CCR4 depl HL FC, Audebert (direct decay)
##   log2FC_dcp2_hl        -- Dcp2 depl HL FC, Audebert (direct decay)
##   log2FC_upf3_hl        -- upf3Δ HL FC, Alalam (direct decay, NMD)
##   log2FC_pat1D          -- pat1Δ, He et al. 2018 (steady-state)
##   log2FC_lsm1D          -- lsm1Δ, He et al. 2018 (steady-state)
##   log2FC_dhh1D          -- dhh1Δ, He et al. 2018 (steady-state)
##   log2FC_Not1_large_YM  -- Not1-AID FC large cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   log2FC_Not1_small_YM  -- Not1-AID FC small cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   log2FC_Pab1_large_YM  -- Pab1-AID FC large cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   log2FC_Pab1_small_YM  -- Pab1-AID FC small cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   log2FC_Xrn1_large_YM  -- Xrn1-AID FC large cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   log2FC_Xrn1_small_YM  -- Xrn1-AID FC small cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   log2FC_eIF4E_large_YM -- eIF4E-AID FC large cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   log2FC_eIF4E_small_YM -- eIF4E-AID FC small cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   log2FC_eIF4G_large_YM -- eIF4G-AID FC large cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   log2FC_eIF4G_small_YM -- eIF4G-AID FC small cells, in-house RNA-seq
##   eIF4G_dep_fc_small    -- eIF4G-AID FC in small cells (EU pulse-chase)
##   eIF4G_dep_fc_large    -- eIF4G-AID FC in large cells (EU pulse-chase)
##   eIF4G_dep_fc_mean     -- eIF4G-AID FC mean (EU pulse-chase)

df_long <- bind_rows(
  df_consensus %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, WT_hl_fc, WT_small_hl, WT_large_hl) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_vijjamarri %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  log2FC_dcp2D     = log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT,
                  log2FC_xrn1D_vij = log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT,
                  TE_vijjamarri    = TE_vijjamarri_WT) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_chappleboim %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  log2FC_not1_60,
                  log2FC_xrn1_60,
                  log2FC_ccr4_60,
                  log2FC_pop2_60,
                  log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_audebert %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl,
                  log2FC_dcp2_hl) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_alalam %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id = name,
                  log2FC_upf3_hl) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_he2018 %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  log2FC_pat1D,
                  log2FC_lsm1D,
                  log2FC_dhh1D) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_yuyang %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  log2FC_Not1_large_YM,
                  log2FC_Not1_small_YM,
                  log2FC_Pab1_large_YM,
                  log2FC_Pab1_small_YM,
                  log2FC_Xrn1_large_YM,
                  log2FC_Xrn1_small_YM,
                  log2FC_eIF4E_large_YM,
                  log2FC_eIF4E_small_YM,
                  log2FC_eIF4G_large_YM,
                  log2FC_eIF4G_small_YM) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_eif4g %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  eIF4G_dep_fc_small,
                  eIF4G_dep_fc_large,
                  eIF4G_dep_fc_mean) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
)

cat("Long table rows:", nrow(df_long), "\n")
cat("Variables:", paste(unique(df_long$variable), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r pivot_wide}
df_wide <- df_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = "variable",
              values_from = "value")

cat("Wide table:", nrow(df_wide), "genes x", ncol(df_wide) - 1, "variables\n")
```

```{r compute_matrix}
variables <- c("WT_hl_fc",
               "WT_small_hl",
               "WT_large_hl",
               "log2FC_dcp2D",
               "log2FC_xrn1D_vij",
               "TE_vijjamarri",
               "log2FC_not1_60",
               "log2FC_xrn1_60",
               "log2FC_ccr4_60",
               "log2FC_pop2_60",
               "log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60",
               "log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl",
               "log2FC_dcp2_hl",
               "log2FC_upf3_hl",
               "log2FC_pat1D",
               "log2FC_lsm1D",
               "log2FC_dhh1D",
               "log2FC_Not1_large_YM",
               "log2FC_Not1_small_YM",
               "log2FC_Pab1_large_YM",
               "log2FC_Pab1_small_YM",
               "log2FC_Xrn1_large_YM",
               "log2FC_Xrn1_small_YM",
               "log2FC_eIF4E_large_YM",
               "log2FC_eIF4E_small_YM",
               "log2FC_eIF4G_large_YM",
               "log2FC_eIF4G_small_YM",
               "eIF4G_dep_fc_small",
               "eIF4G_dep_fc_large",
               "eIF4G_dep_fc_mean")

cor_pairs <- expand.grid(var1 = variables,
                         var2 = variables,
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble()

cor_results <- cor_pairs %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    R = map2_dbl(var1, var2, function(v1, v2) {
      x <- df_wide[[v1]]
      y <- df_wide[[v2]]
      keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
      if (sum(keep) < 10) return(NA_real_)
      cor(x[keep], y[keep], method = "spearman")
    }),
    n = map2_int(var1, var2, function(v1, v2) {
      x <- df_wide[[v1]]
      y <- df_wide[[v2]]
      sum(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & is.finite(x) & is.finite(y))
    })
  )

label_map <- c(
  WT_hl_fc             = "Half-life FC (large/small)",
  WT_small_hl          = "Half-life, small cells",
  WT_large_hl          = "Half-life, large cells",
  log2FC_dcp2D         = "dcp2\u0394 vs WT (Vijjamarri)",
  log2FC_xrn1D_vij     = "xrn1\u0394 vs WT (Vijjamarri)",
  TE_vijjamarri        = "TE, WT (Vijjamarri)",
  log2FC_not1_60       = "Not1-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_xrn1_60       = "XRN1-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_ccr4_60       = "CCR4-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_pop2_60       = "Pop2-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60 = "dcp2-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl   = "Pop2/CCR4 depl HL FC (Audebert)",
  log2FC_dcp2_hl       = "Dcp2 depl HL FC (Audebert)",
  log2FC_upf3_hl       = "upf3\u0394 HL FC (Alalam)",
  log2FC_pat1D         = "pat1\u0394 vs WT (He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_lsm1D         = "lsm1\u0394 vs WT (He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_dhh1D         = "dhh1\u0394 vs WT (He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_Not1_large_YM  = "Not1-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Not1_small_YM  = "Not1-AID FC, small cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Pab1_large_YM  = "Pab1-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Pab1_small_YM  = "Pab1-AID FC, small cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Xrn1_large_YM  = "Xrn1-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Xrn1_small_YM  = "Xrn1-AID FC, small cells (YM)",
  log2FC_eIF4E_large_YM = "eIF4E-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_eIF4E_small_YM = "eIF4E-AID FC, small cells (YM)",
  log2FC_eIF4G_large_YM = "eIF4G-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_eIF4G_small_YM = "eIF4G-AID FC, small cells (YM)",
  eIF4G_dep_fc_small   = "eIF4G-AID FC, small cells (EU)",
  eIF4G_dep_fc_large   = "eIF4G-AID FC, large cells (EU)",
  eIF4G_dep_fc_mean    = "eIF4G-AID FC, mean (EU)")

cor_results <- cor_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label1 = label_map[var1],
    label2 = label_map[var2],
    label1 = factor(label1, levels = label_map),
    label2 = factor(label2, levels = label_map))

## Print correlations with WT_hl_fc
cat("\nCorrelations with WT_hl_fc:\n")
cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "WT_hl_fc", var2 != "WT_hl_fc") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(R)) %>%
  dplyr::select(var2, R, n) %>%
  print(n = 35)
```

```{r r_squared_ceiling}
## R² as percentage of replicate R² ceiling
## Replicate R ≈ 0.5 → R² ceiling = 0.25

r2_ceiling <- 0.5^2

cor_fc_r2 <- cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "WT_hl_fc", var2 != "WT_hl_fc") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(R)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    R2     = R^2,
    R2_pct = round((R2 / r2_ceiling) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(var2, R, n, R2, R2_pct)

cat("\nR² as percentage of replicate ceiling (R²_ceiling = 0.25):\n")
print(cor_fc_r2, n = 35)
```

```{r plot_full_matrix}
label_map_single <- c(
  WT_hl_fc             = "Half-life FC (large/small)",
  WT_small_hl          = "Half-life, small cells",
  WT_large_hl          = "Half-life, large cells",

  log2FC_xrn1D_vij     = "xrn1\u0394 vs WT (Vijjamarri)",
  TE_vijjamarri        = "TE, WT (Vijjamarri)",
  log2FC_not1_60       = "Not1-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_xrn1_60       = "XRN1-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_ccr4_60       = "CCR4-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_pop2_60       = "Pop2-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60 = "dcp2-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl   = "Pop2/CCR4 depl HL FC (Audebert)",
  log2FC_dcp2_hl       = "Dcp2 depl HL FC (Audebert)",
  log2FC_upf3_hl       = "upf3\u0394 HL FC (Alalam)",
  log2FC_pat1D         = "pat1\u0394 vs WT (He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_lsm1D         = "lsm1\u0394 vs WT (He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_dhh1D         = "dhh1\u0394 vs WT (He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_Not1_large_YM  = "Not1-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Not1_small_YM  = "Not1-AID FC, small cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Pab1_large_YM  = "Pab1-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Pab1_small_YM  = "Pab1-AID FC, small cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Xrn1_large_YM  = "Xrn1-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_Xrn1_small_YM  = "Xrn1-AID FC, small cells (YM)",
  log2FC_eIF4E_large_YM = "eIF4E-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_eIF4E_small_YM = "eIF4E-AID FC, small cells (YM)",
  log2FC_eIF4G_large_YM = "eIF4G-AID FC, large cells (YM)",
  log2FC_eIF4G_small_YM = "eIF4G-AID FC, small cells (YM)",

cor_results_plot <- cor_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(R)) %>%
  mutate(
    label1 = factor(label_map_single[var1], levels = label_map_single),
    label2 = factor(label_map_single[var2], levels = label_map_single))

p_matrix_full <- ggplot(cor_results_plot,
                        aes(x = label1, y = label2, fill = R)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(R), "", round(R, 2))),
            size = 3.5, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low      = "#ffa8cb",
                       mid      = "white",
                       high     = "#4575b4",
                       midpoint = 0,
                       limits   = c(-1, 1),
                       name     = "Spearman R") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                                   size = 12, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
    axis.line       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin     = margin(20, 20, 20, 20))

p_matrix_full
ggsave("../figures/GBA_correlation_matrix_full.png",
       plot   = p_matrix_full,
       width  = 44,
       height = 40,
       dpi    = 200)
cat("Saved GBA_correlation_matrix_full.png\n")
```

```{r plot_fc_subset}
## Figure 4, restructured into two panels: decay-rate measurements
## (acute AID depletion, SLAM-seq, EU pulse-chase - minimal
## transcriptional-compensation confound, genuinely probing decay
## kinetics) vs RNA-level measurements (steady-state deletion mutants -
## chronic, confounded by transcriptional buffering, measuring RNA
## level rather than decay per se).
##
## The in-house (_YM) variables are grouped with RNA-level measurements,
## not decay-rate: they are standard total RNA-seq after AID depletion
## (same assay type as Vijjamarri/He et al.), not SLAM-seq or EU
## pulse-chase, so they measure RNA level rather than decay rate
## directly. Supported empirically: the sanity_check_eif4g_xrn1_
## disagreement chunk below shows the in-house Xrn1 and eIF4G
## measurements disagree in SIGN with the more direct Chappleboim/EU
## pulse-chase measurements of the same factors.
##
## Dropped entirely (not real pathway evidence):
##   WT_small_hl, WT_large_hl - raw components WT_hl_fc is computed
##     FROM, not a decay pathway signature.
##   TE_vijjamarri - baseline translation efficiency, not a
##     perturbation fold-change like the other variables here.

decay_rate_vars <- c(
  "log2FC_not1_60", "log2FC_xrn1_60", "log2FC_ccr4_60",
  "log2FC_pop2_60", "log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60",           # Chappleboim, AID 60min
  "log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl", "log2FC_dcp2_hl",              # Audebert, SLAM-seq HL
  "log2FC_upf3_hl",                                     # Alalam, SLAM-seq HL
  "eIF4G_dep_fc_small", "eIF4G_dep_fc_large", "eIF4G_dep_fc_mean"  # EU pulse-chase
)

rna_level_vars <- c(
  "log2FC_dcp2D", "log2FC_xrn1D_vij",                  # Vijjamarri, deletion
  "log2FC_pat1D", "log2FC_lsm1D", "log2FC_dhh1D",       # He et al. 2018, deletion
  "log2FC_Not1_large_YM", "log2FC_Not1_small_YM",
  "log2FC_Pab1_large_YM", "log2FC_Pab1_small_YM",
  "log2FC_Xrn1_large_YM", "log2FC_Xrn1_small_YM",
  "log2FC_eIF4E_large_YM", "log2FC_eIF4E_small_YM",
  "log2FC_eIF4G_large_YM", "log2FC_eIF4G_small_YM"     # in-house, AID depletion (_YM)
)

cor_fc_all <- cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "WT_hl_fc", var2 != "WT_hl_fc")

make_fc_bar <- function(vars, df, bar_title) {
  df_panel <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(var2 %in% vars) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(R) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(label2 = factor(label2, levels = label2))

  ggplot(df_panel, aes(x = R, y = label2, fill = R)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("R = ", round(R, 3),
                                 "  (n = ", format(n, big.mark = ","), ")"),
                  x     = ifelse(R >= 0, R + 0.01, R - 0.01),
                  hjust = ifelse(R >= 0, 0, 1)),
              size = 6, colour = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low      = "#ffa8cb",
                         mid      = "white",
                         high     = "#4575b4",
                         midpoint = 0,
                         limits   = c(-0.5, 0.5),
                         guide    = "none") +
    # clip = "off" stops the R/n labels being invisibly cut where they
    # extend past xlim. xlim widened to leave physical room for the
    # longest label text next to the most extreme bars.
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.65, 0.65), clip = "off") +
    labs(title = bar_title,
         x = "Spearman R with half-life FC (large/small)",
         y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 26) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold"),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = 24, colour = "black"),
      # extra right margin for labels on the widest positive bars,
      # extra left margin so the value labels on negative bars (which
      # extend further left, toward the axis-label region) have a
      # buffer against the long dataset names and don't collide
      plot.margin     = margin(10, 90, 10, 120))
}

p_fc_bar_decay <- make_fc_bar(decay_rate_vars, cor_fc_all,
                              "Decay-rate measurements (acute AID depletion, SLAM-seq, EU pulse-chase)")

p_fc_bar_rnalevel <- make_fc_bar(rna_level_vars, cor_fc_all,
                                 "RNA-level measurements (steady-state deletion mutants, in-house AID depletion RNA-seq)")

print(p_fc_bar_decay)
ggsave("../figures/GBA_correlation_with_hl_fc_decay_rate.png",
       plot   = p_fc_bar_decay,
       width  = 12,
       height = 12,
       dpi    = 150)
cat("Saved GBA_correlation_with_hl_fc_decay_rate.png\n")

print(p_fc_bar_rnalevel)
ggsave("../figures/GBA_correlation_with_hl_fc_rna_level.png",
       plot   = p_fc_bar_rnalevel,
       width  = 12,
       height = 12,
       dpi    = 150)
cat("Saved GBA_correlation_with_hl_fc_rna_level.png\n")

## Combined Figure 3 -- both panels laid out and rendered together as
## one image, rather than two separately-sized standalone PNGs placed
## side-by-side afterward. Placing two independently-sized ggplot PNGs
## next to each other in Word scales each one down without reflowing
## its internal text, so titles and R-value labels get clipped - this
## combines them with patchwork BEFORE rendering, so ggplot lays out
## all text correctly for the final combined width in one pass.
##
## Panel titles shortened here (vs the long standalone titles above)
## since a combined figure needs more compact in-plot titles - the
## full method description already lives in the external figure
## caption, so it doesn't need repeating in the plot title too.
p_fc_bar_decay_combined <- p_fc_bar_decay +
  labs(title = "Decay-rate measurements")

p_fc_bar_rnalevel_combined <- p_fc_bar_rnalevel +
  labs(title = "RNA-level measurements")

p_figure3 <- p_fc_bar_decay_combined / p_fc_bar_rnalevel_combined

print(p_figure3)
## Sized to approximate a slightly-less-than-A4 page (A4 = 8.27 x
## 11.69 in) at print-quality resolution, so labels stay clearly
## legible when the figure is placed at close to full page width in
## the dissertation rather than shrunk to fit a column.
ggsave("../figures/Figure3_GBA_correlation_with_hl_fc.png",
       plot   = p_figure3,
       width  = 15,
       height = 17,
       dpi    = 300)
cat("Saved Figure3_GBA_correlation_with_hl_fc.png\n")
```

```{r eif4g_size_collapse_cumfreq}
## Direct illustration: WT small vs large cells have visibly different
## half-life distributions, but that difference is lost (distributions
## collapse together) once eIF4G is depleted. This is the headline
## figure for the eIF4G section - shows the WT difference is
## eIF4G-dependent, not just correlated with it.
##
## Uses log2(half-life) rather than raw half-life for the x-axis, since
## half-lives are right-skewed; log2 puts small/large comparisons on a
## symmetric, more visually interpretable scale, consistent with how
## FC values are already log2 throughout this project.

df_collapse <- df_eif4g %>%
  transmute(
    gene_id,
    WT_small_log2hl   = log2(MS1039_small_hl_wt),
    WT_large_log2hl   = log2(MS1039_large_hl_wt),
    eIF4G_small_log2hl = log2(MS908_small_hl),
    eIF4G_large_log2hl = log2(MS908_large_hl)
  )

make_size_cumfreq <- function(df, small_col, large_col, condition_label) {

  df_lines <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, all_of(c(small_col, large_col))) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "size", values_to = "log2hl") %>%
    mutate(size = if_else(size == small_col, "Small cells", "Large cells"),
           size = factor(size, levels = c("Small cells", "Large cells"))) %>%
    filter(is.finite(log2hl)) %>%
    group_by(size) %>%
    arrange(log2hl) %>%
    mutate(cumfreq = seq_along(log2hl) / n()) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Wilcoxon rank-sum test: are small and large cell half-lives
  # significantly different under this condition? Note: with n in the
  # thousands, this will likely be significant in both WT and eIF4G
  # panels even if the eIF4G difference is much smaller - p-value alone
  # doesn't distinguish "big shift" from "small but real shift". Report
  # the median difference alongside it, since that's the number that
  # should actually shrink under eIF4G depletion if the collapse claim
  # holds.
  small_vals <- df_lines %>% filter(size == "Small cells") %>% pull(log2hl)
  large_vals <- df_lines %>% filter(size == "Large cells") %>% pull(log2hl)
  w <- wilcox.test(small_vals, large_vals, alternative = "two.sided")
  p_label <- if (w$p.value < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", round(w$p.value, 3))

  median_diff <- median(large_vals) - median(small_vals)

  ggplot(df_lines, aes(x = log2hl, y = cumfreq, colour = size)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Small cells" = col_small, "Large cells" = col_large)) +
    labs(
      title    = condition_label,
      subtitle = paste0("n = ", length(small_vals), " genes  |  Wilcoxon ", p_label,
                        "  |  median diff (large\u2212small) = ", round(median_diff, 2)),
      x        = "log2(half-life)",
      y        = "Cumulative frequency",
      colour   = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

p_collapse_wt <- make_size_cumfreq(df_collapse, "WT_small_log2hl", "WT_large_log2hl",
                                   "WT") +
  labs(tag = "A")

p_collapse_eif4g <- make_size_cumfreq(df_collapse, "eIF4G_small_log2hl", "eIF4G_large_log2hl",
                                      "eIF4G depleted") +
  labs(tag = "B")

# Print the median differences directly for the Results text - the
# subtitle on each panel shows this too, but it's easy to miss the
# actual magnitude of the shrinkage just glancing at the figure.
# NOTE: this is the difference of independent medians (median of large
# minus median of small, each computed on its own non-missing values),
# matching exactly what make_size_cumfreq() computes for the panel
# subtitles above - NOT the median of per-gene paired differences,
# which is a different (and not directly comparable) statistic.
median_diff_wt <- median(df_collapse$WT_large_log2hl, na.rm = TRUE) -
  median(df_collapse$WT_small_log2hl, na.rm = TRUE)
median_diff_eif4g <- median(df_collapse$eIF4G_large_log2hl, na.rm = TRUE) -
  median(df_collapse$eIF4G_small_log2hl, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\nMedian log2(half-life) difference (large - small):\n")
cat("  WT:            ", round(median_diff_wt, 3), "\n")
cat("  eIF4G depleted:", round(median_diff_eif4g, 3), "\n")
cat("  Shrinkage:     ", round(100 * (1 - median_diff_eif4g / median_diff_wt), 1),
    "% reduction\n")

p_collapse_panel <- p_collapse_wt | p_collapse_eif4g

print(p_collapse_panel)

ggsave("../figures/GBA_eIF4G_size_collapse_cumfreq.png",
       plot   = p_collapse_panel,
       width  = 12,
       height = 6,
       dpi    = 150)
cat("Saved GBA_eIF4G_size_collapse_cumfreq.png\n")
```

```{r sanity_check_eif4g_xrn1_disagreement}
## Follow-up sanity check, triggered by Figure 4: two factors show
## opposite-sign correlations with WT_hl_fc depending on which dataset
## measured them, checked directly against each other here (the chunk
## above only checked in-house-small vs Chappleboim for Xrn1/Not1, not
## in-house-large, and didn't check eIF4G at all).
##
## Xrn1: Chappleboim 60min AID gives R = +0.133 with WT_hl_fc (the most
##       consistent positive external decay-pathway signal in the whole
##       analysis). The in-house Xrn1-AID data gives R = -0.009 (small
##       cells) and R = -0.211 (large cells) - the large-cell value is
##       the single most negative bar in the RNA-level panel.
## eIF4G: EU pulse-chase gives the headline opposing-correlation result
##       (small R = +0.184, large R = -0.154). The in-house eIF4G-AID
##       data gives small R = +0.055, large R = +0.207 - large cells is
##       POSITIVE, the opposite sign from the EU pulse-chase large-cell
##       result. Both EU pulse-chase eIF4G points sit in the decay-rate
##       panel; both in-house eIF4G points sit in the RNA-level panel -
##       worth flagging in the caption that this factor is measured by
##       both panels and the two disagree in sign for large cells.
##
## This chunk checks whether the two measurements of the SAME factor
## actually agree with each other directly (not just via their separate
## correlations with WT_hl_fc, which can look different even when the
## underlying data agree reasonably well, or vice versa).

xrn1_large_ym_r <- cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "log2FC_Xrn1_large_YM", var2 == "log2FC_xrn1_60")

eif4g_small_cross_r <- cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "log2FC_eIF4G_small_YM", var2 == "eIF4G_dep_fc_small")

eif4g_large_cross_r <- cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "log2FC_eIF4G_large_YM", var2 == "eIF4G_dep_fc_large")

cat("Direct cross-dataset agreement checks (same factor, two methods):\n")
cat("  Xrn1-AID, large cells: in-house vs Chappleboim  R =",
    round(xrn1_large_ym_r$R, 3), "(n =", xrn1_large_ym_r$n, ")\n")
cat("  eIF4G-AID, small cells: in-house (RNA-seq) vs EU pulse-chase  R =",
    round(eif4g_small_cross_r$R, 3), "(n =", eif4g_small_cross_r$n, ")\n")
cat("  eIF4G-AID, large cells: in-house (RNA-seq) vs EU pulse-chase  R =",
    round(eif4g_large_cross_r$R, 3), "(n =", eif4g_large_cross_r$n, ")\n")

cat("\nFor reference, side-by-side correlations with WT_hl_fc (the",
    "numbers driving the panel-A/panel-B discrepancy):\n")
cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "WT_hl_fc",
                var2 %in% c("log2FC_xrn1_60", "log2FC_Xrn1_small_YM",
                           "log2FC_Xrn1_large_YM",
                           "eIF4G_dep_fc_small", "eIF4G_dep_fc_large",
                           "log2FC_eIF4G_small_YM", "log2FC_eIF4G_large_YM")) %>%
  dplyr::select(var2, R, n) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

p_xrn1_large_cross <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_wide,
  x_col     = "log2FC_Xrn1_large_YM",
  y_col     = "log2FC_xrn1_60",
  x_lab     = "log2 FC after Xrn1-AID depletion, large cells (YM)",
  y_lab     = "log2 FC after XRN1-AID depletion 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  point_col = col_large,
  xlim      = c(-5, 5),
  ylim      = c(-1, 3)) +
  labs(tag = "A") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))

p_eif4g_small_cross <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_wide,
  x_col     = "log2FC_eIF4G_small_YM",
  y_col     = "eIF4G_dep_fc_small",
  x_lab     = "log2 FC after eIF4G-AID depletion, small cells (YM, RNA-seq)",
  y_lab     = "log2 FC after eIF4G-AID depletion, small cells (EU pulse-chase)",
  point_col = col_small,
  xlim      = c(-5, 5),
  ylim      = c(-3, 1)) +
  labs(tag = "B") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))

p_eif4g_large_cross <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_wide,
  x_col     = "log2FC_eIF4G_large_YM",
  y_col     = "eIF4G_dep_fc_large",
  x_lab     = "log2 FC after eIF4G-AID depletion, large cells (YM, RNA-seq)",
  y_lab     = "log2 FC after eIF4G-AID depletion, large cells (EU pulse-chase)",
  point_col = col_large,
  xlim      = c(-5, 5),
  ylim      = c(-3, 1)) +
  labs(tag = "C") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))

p_disagreement_panel <- p_xrn1_large_cross | p_eif4g_small_cross | p_eif4g_large_cross

print(p_disagreement_panel)
ggsave("../figures/GBA_yuyang_disagreement_check.png",
       plot   = p_disagreement_panel,
       width  = 22,
       height = 7,
       dpi    = 150)
cat("Saved GBA_yuyang_disagreement_check.png\n")

cat("\nINTERPRETATION GUIDE:\n")
cat("- If the direct cross-dataset R (top of this chunk) is reasonably",
    "positive, the two datasets broadly agree at the individual-gene",
    "level even though their separate correlations with WT_hl_fc",
    "differ in sign - likely a real difference in how each dataset",
    "relates to the size effect, not one dataset being wrong.\n")
cat("- If the direct cross-dataset R is near zero or negative, that's a",
    "stronger signal that at least one dataset has a real issue (batch",
    "effect, mislabelled samples, processing bug) worth investigating.\n")
```

```{r figure8_eif4g_vs_te}
## Figure 8, panels A/B -- eIF4G depletion FC vs translation efficiency
## Tests whether genes most affected by eIF4G depletion have higher TE
## (would suggest codon-optimality confounds the eIF4G-sensitivity signal)
## TE: rRNA-depleted monosome+polysome, size-separated (in-house)

df_TE <- read_csv("../tables/translation_efficiency.csv",
                  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id,
                TE_small = TE_rRNAdep_MandP_small_YM,
                TE_large = TE_rRNAdep_MandP_large_YM)

df_eif4g_te <- df_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, eIF4G_dep_fc_small, eIF4G_dep_fc_large) %>%
  inner_join(df_TE, by = "gene_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(eIF4G_dep_fc_small), !is.na(eIF4G_dep_fc_large),
         !is.na(TE_small), !is.na(TE_large),
         is.finite(eIF4G_dep_fc_small), is.finite(eIF4G_dep_fc_large),
         is.finite(TE_small), is.finite(TE_large),
         TE_small > 0, TE_large > 0)

cat("Genes for eIF4G vs TE plot:", nrow(df_eif4g_te), "\n")

r_small <- cor(df_eif4g_te$eIF4G_dep_fc_small,
               log2(df_eif4g_te$TE_small),
               method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
r_large <- cor(df_eif4g_te$eIF4G_dep_fc_large,
               log2(df_eif4g_te$TE_large),
               method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

cat("eIF4G FC small vs TE small R:", round(r_small, 3), "\n")
cat("eIF4G FC large vs TE large R:", round(r_large, 3), "\n")

p_te_small <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_eif4g_te %>% mutate(TE_small_log2 = log2(TE_small)),
  x_col     = "TE_small_log2",
  y_col     = "eIF4G_dep_fc_small",
  x_lab     = "Translation efficiency, small cells (log2)",
  y_lab     = "log2 FC after eIF4G depletion, small cells",
  point_col = col_small,
  ylim      = c(-3, 1)) +
  labs(tag = "A") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))

p_te_large <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_eif4g_te %>% mutate(TE_large_log2 = log2(TE_large)),
  x_col     = "TE_large_log2",
  y_col     = "eIF4G_dep_fc_large",
  x_lab     = "Translation efficiency, large cells (log2)",
  y_lab     = "log2 FC after eIF4G depletion, large cells",
  point_col = col_large,
  ylim      = c(-3, 1)) +
  labs(tag = "B") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))
```

```{r figure8_wt_size_fc_vs_te}
## Figure 8, panels C/D -- WT half-life fold change (large/small) vs
## translation efficiency. This is the direct codon-optimality test: does
## TE predict the size-dependent stability effect itself, independent of
## eIF4G? The panels above (A/B) test something different -- whether
## eIF4G-SENSITIVE genes are TE-biased, not whether the underlying size
## effect tracks with TE. Both questions matter for ruling out
## codon-optimality as a confound.
##
## Uses the full df_wide/TE join (not restricted to the eIF4G-filtered
## gene set used for A/B above), so n differs between the two rows --
## reported separately below and in the panel captions.
## Depends on df_TE from the eif4g_vs_te chunk above -- run that chunk
## first.

df_size_te <- df_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, WT_hl_fc) %>%
  inner_join(df_TE, by = "gene_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(WT_hl_fc), !is.na(TE_small), !is.na(TE_large),
         is.finite(WT_hl_fc), is.finite(TE_small), is.finite(TE_large),
         TE_small > 0, TE_large > 0)

cat("Genes for WT size FC vs TE plot:", nrow(df_size_te), "\n")

r_size_small <- cor(df_size_te$WT_hl_fc,
                    log2(df_size_te$TE_small),
                    method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
r_size_large <- cor(df_size_te$WT_hl_fc,
                    log2(df_size_te$TE_large),
                    method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

cat("WT_hl_fc vs TE small R:", round(r_size_small, 3), "\n")
cat("WT_hl_fc vs TE large R:", round(r_size_large, 3), "\n")

## Axis trimming for display only -- the unfiltered gene set includes a
## handful of genes with extreme TE_large values, likely low-read-count
## artefacts. Spearman R is rank-based and computed on the full data;
## this trim only clips what's plotted so the panel isn't crushed by
## a few outliers.

te_small_xlim <- quantile(log2(df_size_te$TE_small), c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
te_large_xlim <- quantile(log2(df_size_te$TE_large), c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)

p_te_size_small <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_size_te %>% mutate(TE_small_log2 = log2(TE_small)),
  x_col     = "TE_small_log2",
  y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
  x_lab     = "Translation efficiency, small cells (log2)",
  y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
  point_col = col_small,
  xlim      = te_small_xlim,
  ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "C") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))

p_te_size_large <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_size_te %>% mutate(TE_large_log2 = log2(TE_large)),
  x_col     = "TE_large_log2",
  y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
  x_lab     = "Translation efficiency, large cells (log2)",
  y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
  point_col = col_large,
  xlim      = te_large_xlim,
  ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "D") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))
```

```{r figure8_combined}
## Figure 8, combined -- 2x2 panel.
## Top row (A/B): eIF4G-depletion sensitivity vs TE.
## Bottom row (C/D): the size-dependent stability effect itself vs TE.
## Both rows near-zero R would argue against codon-optimality as a
## confound for either the eIF4G mechanism or the size effect directly --
## that interpretive claim belongs in Discussion, not here.

p_figure8 <- (p_te_small | p_te_large) / (p_te_size_small | p_te_size_large)

p_figure8
ggsave("../figures/Figure8_eIF4G_TE_size_effect.png",
       plot   = p_figure8,
       width  = 12,
       height = 12,
       dpi    = 150)
cat("Saved Figure8_eIF4G_TE_size_effect.png\n")
```
